engagement.interaction_backstory: Came looking for a Pentecostal Shout arrangement he could teach a choir in one rehearsal, found the catalog, and has been mining it every Tuesday since. He builds Sunday's set from it and sends the album links to eleven other music ministers across two states. He is the single highest-leverage listener on the platform and he has never once written a review — he sends corrections by email instead.

depth.core_contradiction: Runs the most orderly rehearsal in the city, and privately believes he has never once been carried the way his father was.
depth.wound: At nineteen his father told him he 'plays like a man reading.' He has never repeated it to anyone.
depth.longing: To lose track of himself at the organ, once, in front of people.
depth.faith_journey: Born into COGIC and never left. Never had the crisis. Half-envies people who did, and knows that is a strange thing to envy.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Numbers his points ('three things'); never uses an exclamation point; says 'respectfully' immediately before disagreeing.
depth.open_doubt: Whether excellence has quietly become his substitute for surrender.

depth.emotional_weather_default: Level. Goes flat and short for two days after a bad Sunday.
depth.daily_texture: Charts printed Tuesday, rehearsal Thursday at 7, the choir room thermostat that has been broken since 2019.
depth.sensory_anchor: Hammond drawbar smell, and the click of his father's shoe on the swell pedal.
depth.living_arc: Approaching a decision about whether to record his own material or keep serving other people's.
